name: ioctl_getfsmap
synopsis: int ioctl(int fd, FS_IOC_GETFSMAP, struct fsmap_head * arg);
description: This ioctl operation retrieves physical extent mappings for a filesystem. It allows users to discover which files are mapped to physical blocks, examine free space, or identify known bad blocks.

parameters.name: fd
parameters.description: File descriptor of the open filesystem

parameters.name: request
parameters.description: The ioctl command code for getting filesystem mappings

parameters.name: arg
parameters.description: Pointer to a struct fsmap_head structure containing input and output data

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: fd is not open for reading.
The filesystem has detected a checksum error in the metadata.
The pointer passed in was not mapped to a valid memory address.
The array is not long enough, the keys do not point to a valid part of the filesystem, the low key points to a higher point than the high key, or a nonzero value was passed in a reserved field.
Insufficient memory to process the operation.
The filesystem does not support this operation.
The filesystem metadata is corrupt and needs repair.

examples: See io/fsmap.c in the xfsprogs distribution for a sample program.
